_comment: Deterministic Sentry evidence. Every stack frame names a file that exists in this repository so evidence can be cross-referenced against real code.

issues.title: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')

issues.userImpact: Same fault reached through bulk import instead of the status route.

issues.userImpact: Three internal agents see a slow ticket list. No customer impact.

issues.userImpact: Unclear. No line number captured and no reproduction.

issues.title: PriorityMappingError: unrecognized severity 'SEV2'
issues.workaround: An agent can set the priority manually after the ticket is created.
issues.userImpact: Pager-bridge tickets land at default priority instead of their real one.
